_comment_1: Per-SERVED-MODEL policy the sidecar applies AFTER _resolve_alias, keyed on cfg.model_id (the concrete active_chat_model_id), NOT the alias. opencode only ever sends the alias, so model-specific prompt tuning cannot live in opencode.jsonc — it lives here. See routing_service_integration_plan.md §11.
_comment_2: Field: system_prompt = filename under routing/policy/prompts/ to REPLACE the request's system message with (weak-local task-hardening). Applies on the LOCAL path only; cloud requests are never transformed. Unknown model_id => no transform (safe default).
_comment_3: NOTE: task-tool enable/disable is deliberately NOT here. The `task` tool is load-bearing — the primary agent (superclaw-default) reaches its subagents (email/local-file/websearch) ONLY via task. Dropping it by MODEL would strip delegation from the default agent on any weak-local turn. Per-agent task permission lives in opencode.jsonc; the sidecar only OVERRIDES it per-agent via the LATENTFACTOR_DISABLE_TASK_AGENTS env var (for benchmarking a single agent without delegation). See prompt_transform.apply_model_policy.
